objective: Search the Frozen Road, far to the north-east, for Kagerou's trail
title: The Frozen Road
summary: A traveller saw a man who melted the snow where he walked. Kagerou's clones would rather you didn't follow.

steps.title: The Frozen Road
steps.sub: Two nights before the new moon

say: Academy? Then you're the one he said would come.

lines: A man walked past my lantern at dawn. Red coat, no cloak, in this cold. The snow melted where he stepped.
He bought tea from me and paid too much. He said a child from Emberwood would come asking, and that I should tell them where he went.
Up the road, to the shrine. But he left company behind. Look at the trees.

beats.text: Break the ambush in the snow

lines: Fire clones in the snow. They hissed when they fell. I'll be hearing that all winter.
He's not hiding, you know. A man who wants to hide doesn't pay for the tea.
He wants to be found by you. Whatever you are to him, go carefully.
